title: ochna mexicana
intro: Ochna mexicana, commonly known as the bird's eye or Mickey mouse plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ochnaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in Ochna mexicana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of Ochna mexicana plant include the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its use as an anti-diarrheal and anti-spasmodic agent.
